name: qfabric-monorepo
description: Interactive quantum visuals for the web.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/remark-plugin/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/astro/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm check:packages && pnpm smoke
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && biome format --write . && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.release: pnpm build && pnpm publish -r --access public --no-git-checks && changeset tag
